songs.title: Living Room Places 🛋️
songs.tune: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
lines: The lamp is next to the sofa,
Next to the sofa, next to the sofa,
The table's in front of the sofa
In the living room at home!
The dog is between the curtains,
Between the curtains, between the curtains,
The cat is behind the sofa
In the living room at home!
n: 곡조: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
next to·in front of·behind·between에 맞춰 손 하나를 다른 손의 옆·앞·뒤·사이로 옮겨요.
songs.imgPrompt: A cozy living room with a lamp next to a sofa, a dog peeking between curtains and a cat hiding behind the sofa.
